In agreement with predictions from these models, we show that minimal changes in the shape of the environment in which rats are exploring can substantially alter correlated activity patterns among place-modulated granule cells in the dentate gyrus. When the environments are made more different, new cell populations are recruited in CA3 but not in the dentate gyrus. These results imply a dual mechanism for pattern separation in which signals from the entorhinal cortex can be decorrelated both by changes in coincidence patterns in the dentate gyrus and by recruitment of nonoverlapping cell assemblies in CA3.<\/jats:p>","DOI":"10.1126\/science.1135801","type":"journal-article","created":{"date-parts":[[2007,2,15]],"date-time":"2007-02-15T16:52:05Z","timestamp":1171558325000},"page":"961-966","source":"Crossref","is-referenced-by-count":1515,"title":["Pattern Separation in the Dentate Gyrus and CA3 of the Hippocampus"],"prefix":"10.1126","volume":"315","author":[{"given":"Jill K.","family":"Leutgeb","sequence":"first","affiliation":[{"name":"Centre for the Biology of Memory, Norwegian University of Science and Technology, 7489 Trondheim, Norway."}],"role":[{"vocabulary":"crossref","role":"author"}]},{"given":"Stefan","family":"Leutgeb","sequence":"additional","affiliation":[{"name":"Centre for the Biology of Memory, Norwegian University of Science and Technology, 7489 Trondheim, Norway."}],"role":[{"vocabulary":"crossref","role":"author"}]},{"given":"May-Britt","family":"Moser","sequence":"additional","affiliation":[{"name":"Centre for the Biology of Memory, Norwegian University of Science and Technology, 7489 Trondheim, Norway."}],"role":[{"vocabulary":"crossref","role":"author"}]},{"given":"Edvard I.","family":"Moser","sequence":"additional","affiliation":[{"name":"Centre for the Biology of Memory, Norwegian University of Science and Technology, 7489 Trondheim, Norway."}],"role":[{"vocabulary":"crossref","role":"author"}]}],"member":"221","reference":[{"key":"e_1_3_1_2_2","first-page":"1","year":"1989","unstructured":"B.
